name: TAU Urban Acoustic Scenes 2020 Mobile (DCASE 2020 Task 1A)
description: TAU Urban Acoustic Scenes 2020 Mobile is an audio dataset for acoustic scene classification with mismatched recording devices. Developed by Tampere University for DCASE 2020 Task 1A, it contains 23,040 10-second audio segments recorded across 10 urban acoustic scene categories in 12 European cities using 4 real physical recording devices and 16 simulated devices.
